title: Animated Spawn Eggs
description: Now all spawn eggs will have some animation!
body:
![Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Animated_Spawn_Eggs/MP_AnimatedSpawnEggs_header.webp) Animated Spawn Eggs adds unique animations to every spawn egg in Minecraft, making them feel much more alive and dynamic inside your inventory. The pack also updates the spawn egg textures in 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 to match the newer vanilla designs from recent Minecraft versions. The designer of these textures is Ferrum. ### Do you need a server to play with your friends?

For exceptional server hosting services, look no further than **[BisectHosting](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)**. Of course, you can install all the mods or modpacks you want, and their support team is always available to help you. **[With the code "Lupin" you will get a 25% discount! Click here!](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin)** ![Description](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Animated_Spawn_Eggs/MP_AnimatedSpawnEggs_description.webp) Each egg is animated based on the mob it represents. Endermen disappear and reappear, Creepers flash before exploding and many other mobs have their own small details and effects that bring them to life. The pack also updates the spawn egg textures in Minecraft 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 to use the newer vanilla designs from recent versions of the game, giving older versions a more modern look while staying fully consistent with Minecraft’s original art style. ![FAQ](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Animated_Spawn_Eggs/MP_AnimatedSpawnEggs_faq.webp) ### Does it work on servers? ### Sure! Remember that the best way to play with mods and friends is with BisectHosting, and by **[clicking on this link you can get a 25% discount](https://bisecthosting.com/lupin).** ### Can this resourcepack be used in modpacks? ### Of course!
